description: This Java class 'ContentKeywordIndex' handles indexing of content for keyword search in the OFBiz framework. It gathers various content-related data, processes keywords, and stores them for search optimization.

classes.name: ContentKeywordIndex
classes.description: Handles indexing of content for keyword search, including gathering content data, processing keywords, and storing them for search.

methods.name: forceIndexKeywords
methods.description: Forces reindexing of keywords for a given content.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Indexes keywords for a given content, with optional full reindexing.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method that performs the indexing process, gathering various content data, processing keywords, and storing them.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Adds content from a DataResource to the index with specified weight.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a string field from a GenericValue to the list of strings for indexing, with a default weight.
